action: label the columns for what they measure

unmodified.molecule_features: no numeric value changed; only two column names

producer_rule.hbd: sum(1 for i in heavy if atoms[i-1] in (N,O) and imph[i] > 0)
producer_rule.hba: sum(1 for i in heavy if atoms[i-1] in (N,O))
producer_rule.reading: the producer counts heteroatoms: hba is the N+O atom count (100% of the sample), hbd is the N/O atoms carrying an implicit H (93.1% of a naive NH/OH count, 91.7% of RDKit Lipinski HBD -- it differs where the molfile carries explicit H or a charged N/O). Both are near-descriptors whose names read as Lipinski; they are renamed so no query mistakes one for the other. Lipinski HBA/HBD stay available from molecule.props (RDKit, 100%).
